items.title: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget
items.summary: Influential Labour figures had been pushing for equalising CGT and income tax, but critics have said this could drive wealthy people out of Britain.

items.title: How the attack on an Australian MP unfolded
items.summary: BBC's Katy Watson is in Wangaratta visiting the scene of the incident and the church where the community has held a vigil for the independent MP.

items.title: We asked teens what schools should teach them about work. This is what they said
items.summary: Teenagers say they want more work experience at school and opportunities to improve their communication skills.

items.title: Storm Austen to bring severe gales to UK as weather warning issued
items.summary: The first named storm of the season - Austen - will bring damaging winds and heavy rain to parts of the UK on Friday.

items.title: Three children injured after school bus roof ripped off in crash
items.summary: Three children receive hospital treatment after a bus on its way to Ysgol Gyfun Gwent Is Coed crashes.

items.title: Criminals detained in hospital set to lose benefits
items.summary: The families of the victims of Nottingham killer Valdo Calocane had been campaigning for the change.

items.title: Burnham vows end to 'rip-off parking charges' under new rules
items.summary: The changes come after concerns that penalties issued by private providers are too harsh and leave motorists unfairly punished.

items.title: Can a simple photo of your face reveal how ill you are?
